sql:
WITH sma_10001_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', month_date) AS metric_time__month
    , member_id AS __monthly_buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 2 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END AS __monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."member_month_activity" member_month_activity_semantic_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_8.monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_15.monthly_repeat_rate) AS monthly_repeat_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10001_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_8
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS monthly_repeat_rate
  FROM sma_10001_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_15
